_comment: Three defects. A bare BANISH banishes from the TOP OF THE DECK by default, where 'banish IT' means the card just discarded -- so it milled instead. The payoff read REF_PITCH_IS pitch 6, a PITCH VALUE test on a scale that only runs 1-3, so 'if it has 6 or more {p}' was false for every card in the game; it is a POWER test on the revealed card. And the payoff sat in a SECOND ability, where it could not see the first's refs at all -- a reference scope lasts one ability execution -- so the two halves are now one. NOT FIXED: 'until end of turn' is a turn-scoped injected trigger, the known DSL gap; this ON_DISCARD fires whenever the card is in a listening zone rather than only for the turn Berserk was played.
